text: Your demo is a script, not a screen recording. Argo turns a Playwright walkthrough into a polished product video with voiceover, camera direction, and smart export built in.

overlay.title: Demos as code.
overlay.body: Voiceover, overlays, camera effects, preview, and export — one pipeline.

text: Start with argo init, convert an existing Playwright test, or import any screen recording with argo import. Scenes, narration, and overlays live in one manifest.

overlay.title: Playwright is the source of truth.
overlay.body: Scaffold, convert, or write from scratch.

text: Seven TTS engines. Start local with Kokoro, bring a HuggingFace model, switch to open-a-eye or Eleven Labs and many more for the polished cut, or clone your own voice with MLX audio.

overlay.text: 7 engines — local, cloud, or your own voice

text: Preview turns your recording into an edit bay. Scrub by scene, rewrite a line, drag overlays to snap them into position, and re-export without re-recording.
Direct the viewer's eye with code. Spotlight a button, pulse a focus ring, dim the noise, highlight the cursor, zoom into a card, add motion blur to camera moves, and celebrate with confetti.

Export is where the polish lands. Add a shader transition, generate background music from a prompt right in the preview, stamp a watermark, freeze a hero frame, and ship subtitles, chapters, reports, and social formats from the same timeline — GPU-accelerated on every platform.

overlay.title: Smart export, not just encoding.
overlay.body: Shader transitions, music, watermark, freeze-frame, chapters, GPU encoding — one timeline.

text: The studio polish pack. Frame your recording on any background. Drop in blocks from the catalog for posts, notifications, metrics, flowcharts, and brand outros. Layer GreenSock-driven motion on headlines and blocks, add motion blur to camera zooms, slow down a hero scene to half speed, and drop arrow annotations to guide the viewer's eye.

overlay.title: The Screen Studio look, in config.
overlay.body: Frame, block catalog, GSAP motion, motion blur, per-scene speed, arrows.

text: As your demo catalog grows, Argo scales with it. Validate catches wiring bugs, doctor checks the environment, pipeline dash dash all renders everything, and the dashboard shows status at a glance.
Under the hood, it is still Playwright. A few helpers for narration, overlays, typing, and camera effects turn familiar test code into a demo system.
Overlays adapt to your page. Toggle the theme, and the overlay contrast follows automatically. One pipeline, every output you need.

overlay.title: npm i -D @argo-video/cli
overlay.body: npx argo init && npx argo pipeline my-demo

text: This demo was recorded by Argo. Directed by code. Shipped by one command.
